label: t06_01
text: This is Medali! Kind of sounds like “medley,”\nright? A fitting name for a town with such a mix\r\nof people and things!

label: t06_10
text: Have you been to the Treasure Eatery? I hear the\nGym Leader is a regular there!

label: t06_18
text: We have the best food in all of Paldea! Come on\nin and give it a try!

label: t06_19
text: Our dishes here at Seafood Fresco are fresh and\npacked full of minerals!

label: t06_22
text: I think your Pokémon is saying it wants to come\neat here at my restaurant!

label: t06_31
text: I hear fancy restaurants have something called\na “dress code”...\r\nI wonder what kind of code that is?

label: t06_32
text: I want to feed my Pokémon something tasty!\nI need to save up my money.

label: t06_33
text: Our spicy dishes are the best! Come on in!

label: t06_42
text: We are currently open to customers with or\nwithout reservations.

label: t06_59
text: There’s a big gate at the top of the path leading\nto the Great Crater of Paldea. You can’t get in.

label: t06_60
text: I heard that there’s an off-limits facility called\nthe Zero Gate behind the gate up that path!

label: t06_61
text:
Medali’s most famous restaurant, the Treasure
Eatery, is right here!\c
We also have the secret dish for those of you
currently taking on the Gym Test!

label: t06_65
text: I heard that you can change your Pokémon’s Tera\nType at the Treasure Eatery, but the chef turned\r\nme away the moment I asked about it...

label: t06_79
text: How about a sandwich? They’re tempting even\nwhen you’re full—that’s how good they are!

label: t06_101
text: Before climbing Glaseado Mountain, I like to\nvisit the shopping area in Medali and fuel up\r\nwith something to eat.

label: t06_106
text: This town is an important hub here in Paldea.\c\nLots of people from other places come through,\nso naturally, lots of restaurants have popped up.

label: t06_107
text: My little Greedent here has gotten bigger\nrecently. I wonder if it’s about time to move to a\r\nbigger living space...

label: t06_109
text: The way up Glaseado Mountain is rough! Be sure\nyou’re prepared if you’re headed out that way.

label: t06_115
text: This town doesn’t have a battle court, y’know?\nI wonder where you battle the Gym Leader...

label: t06_117
text: Long ago, the space at the bottom of these stairs\nwas a stage for plays and concerts.

label: t06_133
text: Hello there, young’un. Are you a student? The\nTreasure Hunt’s rolled around again, then, eh?
